title: Identifying E3 Ligases for Biodegraders via Cell-Based Screening
author: Sorbara, Cristol, et al.

steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction: Make two complete media formulations: (1) HEK293T medium – DMEM supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 100 U·mL⁻¹ Penicillin‑Streptomycin; (2) HeLa S3 medium – DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS, 1 % Penicillin‑Streptomycin, and optionally 3 µg·mL⁻¹ Blasticidin. Keep all media sterile and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare polybrene stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve polybrene to 8 mg·mL⁻¹ in ddH₂O, filter‑sterilize through a 0.2 µm filter, aliquot 50 µL portions, and store at –20 °C (stable ≤2 years). Discard any aliquot after use.

steps.title: Prepare epoxomicin stock
steps.instruction: Resuspend epoxomicin to 1 mM in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) inside a sterile tissue‑culture hood, aliquot 10 µL portions, and store at –20 °C (stable ≤2 years). Discard any aliquot after use.

steps.title: Generate homogeneous GFP‑POI HeLa S3 line
steps.instruction: Obtain a uniform population of HeLa S3 cells stably expressing H2B‑GFP‑ALFA‑KRASG12V166 by detaching, counting, diluting, sorting, and expanding the cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL trypsin‑EDTA to a T‑175 flask containing HeLa S3 cells at 70–80 % confluence.
Add 8.5 mL supplemented DMEM to neutralize the trypsin and mix gently by pipetting.
Dilute the cell suspension to 10 × 10⁶ cells·mL⁻¹ in PBS containing 4 % FBS.
Sort the cells on a FACS MELODY using a narrow gate on the GFP‑positive population, collecting into a 15 mL Falcon tube that already contains 2 mL supplemented DMEM; aim to collect 0.5–1 × 10⁶ cells.
Centrifuge the tube 5 min at 800 × g at 22 °C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL supplemented DMEM.
Plate the resuspended cells into a T‑25 flask and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Expand the culture to the desired quantity and freeze a stock of at least 8–10 vials, each containing 5 × 10⁶ cells.

steps.title: Quantify GFP median by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Run the screened cells on a flow cytometer, measure the median fluorescence intensity (MFI) of GFP in the mCherry‑transfected population, and calculate normalized GFP MFI as (MFI of biodegrader ÷ MFI of negative control) × 100 %.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of screening data
steps.instruction: Perform the screen in triplicate (as done for 7 E3 ligases). Analyze the normalized GFP MFI values using a one‑way ANOVA followed by Dunnett post‑hoc tests comparing each condition to the negative control; a biodegrader is a hit when its normalized GFP MFI is significantly lower than control. For larger screens, adjust the statistical approach accordingly.
